title: macOS kithctl watch: AppleScript injection via embedded double-quotes in sender/body
description: watch.rs:213-228 uses format!("{:?}", sender_clean) to produce an AppleScript string literal, on the basis that Rust Debug escaping produces safe AppleScript. This is not formally correct: Rust Debug escapes '"' as '\"' but AppleScript string parsing under pathological input is not specified to handle arbitrary backslash sequences. sanitize_sender strips only '\0\r\n\t'; characters like '"' and '&' remain. A sender string like '" & do shell script "id" & "' after Debug escaping produces a string where the quoting may not be fully safe across all osascript versions. Fix: strip all characters outside printable ASCII (0x20-0x7e) excluding double-quote from sender_clean and preview_clean before splicing into AppleScript literals, and add test vector with embedded quotes.
